newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Lenzing sees further price rises in '97.
newsitem.headline: Lenzing sees further price rises in '97.

text.p: Austrian viscose fibre maker Lenzing said on Tuesday it was aiming to implement European price increases in the fourth quarter.
Chief executive Heinrich Stepniczka said the firm had already pushed through two price increases amounting to just under 10 percent.
"That certainly is not sufficient, but it is a step in the right direction," he told Reuters. "We expect to increase prices of certain fibres, maybe in the fourth quarter."
Modal and non-woven fibres were the most likely candidates for price increases, he added.
The strong dollar was helping the firm, he said, but there had been no significant upturn in demand.
